record_title: Rounded proportional allocation can reverse gradient-clustered variance reduction
provenance: Scientific record deriving the exact variance of an integer-allocated stratified meta-gradient estimator and a rational cosine-compatible counterexample showing that nearest-integer proportional allocation can reverse the variance advantage of exact proportional clustering.
limitations: The result preserves the source theorem under exact proportional integer allocation and addresses only the rounded practical allocation under independent with-replacement sampling. It does not evaluate the published experiments, infer their unreported realized cluster sizes, or analyze without-replacement sampling.

artifact_inventory.purpose: Exact rational verification of the two-cluster rounded-allocation variance reversal and the exact-proportional comparison.
Executed exact-rational output of the rounding counterexample verification.
